purpose.zh: 练大腿内侧，提升髋部控制
purpose.en: Build the inner thigh and improve hip control.

text.zh: 腿伸直向内拉向支撑腿，骨盆保持水平
text.en: Pull the straight leg in toward the standing leg with your pelvis level

text.zh: 弹力带固定在牢固的低处，椅子只用来扶稳
text.en: Anchor the band to a secure low post; use the chair only for balance.

text.zh: 慢慢放回，在无痛范围内做
text.en: Return slowly and stay in a pain-free range.

commonErrors.en: Leaning the upper body to move the leg.

cautions.zh: 用轻阻力弹力带，检查固定点牢固；出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Use a light band and check the anchor is secure; stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 不要把弹力带固定在椅子上
cautions.en: Never anchor the band to the chair.
